title: Node
description: Designed (docs/nodes.md 1 "Node"), not implemented. One machine in the registry: a station, a GPU worker, or both. The hub is not a node. Credentials are not part of this object: a node has a station token (sz1.<id>.<secret>), a worker token (sw1.<id>.<secret>) or both, each kept hash-only on the hub, and their id is the node's id.

id.description: The node's id: 1 to 40 characters, lower-case letters, digits, `_` and `-`, starting with a letter or digit. The same shape as station and worker ids today (sizeup/cloud/stations.py ID, sizeup/cloud/sttworkers.py ID), and one namespace for every node.

name.description: Free text for people, at most 60 characters.

kind.description: Derived by the hub from the credentials the node has, never set: `station` (a station token), `worker` (a worker token), `station+worker` (both). A reader takes a value it does not know as unknown and never refuses the body for it.
